get.description: Restores the same active account and returns expiresIn as the remaining absolute lifetime. A successful login lasts 3600 seconds; restore, refresh and questionnaire activity never renew it. Expired, revoked and archived-account credentials are denied across workers and restarts.

post.description: Local/test verification creates or reuses the database profile and sets a one-hour HttpOnly account cookie backed by PostgreSQL. Mock OTP is forbidden in staging/production. No real phone ownership is asserted.

get.description: Account-generation scoped bookmarks. PUT expresses saved state and DELETE hides the association; retries are idempotent. Only loan UUID and optional own visible historyId are accepted. No client owner, score or loan facts are stored. GET is cursor-paginated with no-store; snapshot display context is read from its original immutable server tables.

post.description: Creates a 30-minute session and its unpredictable HttpOnly proof cookie. Keep this cookie jar; the secret is never returned in JSON.

get.description: Requires the creator's per-session HttpOnly proof cookie, preserved by this cookie jar. ID alone, legacy constant or another session's cookie is forbidden. After account binding, the same active account session is also required. Valid expired proof returns 410; missing/invalid proof and unknown IDs return the same safe 403. No TTL renewal.
